name: Data Dictionary and DSS Instance datasets test project
description:
This is an example project designed to demonstrate the following DSS plugins:
[Data Dictionary Agent Plugin](https://github.com/THE-MOLECULAR-MAN/dss-plugin-data-dictionary-agent/releases/)

[Datasets about Dataiku Instance Plugin](https://github.com/THE-MOLECULAR-MAN/dss-plugin-xzibit/releases/)

It includes:
* uses of all the datasets provided by the Datasets about Dataiku Instance Plugin
* a scenario that runs the Generate Descriptions macro
* an agent built to query information about this DSS instance


This data processing flow is composed of two main zones: "Internal Stat datasets - not from plugin" and "Plugin datasets." 

In the "Internal Stat datasets - not from plugin" zone, the flow is designed to transform and cache datasets related to scenario runs, cluster tasks, job executions, and software project commits. The primary objective is to enhance the usability and accessibility of these datasets by converting timestamps to a consistent, human-readable format and ensuring data consistency. This zone processes scenario runs by caching information about their timing, outcomes, and user details. It also handles cluster tasks by converting UNIX timestamps to a readable date format, making the data easier to interpret. Job executions are synchronized to ensure up-to-date metadata, and software project commits are processed to provide a clear view of commit history. The output datasets are optimized for quick access and are ready for various analytical tasks, such as performance monitoring and project management.

In the "Plugin datasets" zone, the flow manages and caches live data from the Dataiku DSS platform. It involves synchronizing datasets from different aspects of the DSS environment, such as connections, meanings, applications, clusters, users, plugins, agents, web applications, code environments, datasets, agent tools, projects, and recipes. The primary goal is to create cached versions of these datasets to improve performance and efficiency. The flow produces a set of cached datasets, each corresponding to a specific aspect of the DSS environment, such as code environments, plugins, meanings, users, agents, connections, web applications, agent tools, recipes, projects, datasets, applications, and clusters. This setup ensures that the most current and relevant data is readily available in a cached format, facilitating quick access and efficient data management across the DSS platform.

Overall, this flow enhances data accessibility and performance by preparing and caching datasets for efficient analysis and management, ensuring data consistency and quick retrieval across both internal statistics and plugin-related data.

Description generated on 12/6/2025
shortDesc:

It has an agent to query internal DSS datasets.
